chapterInfo.content:
14
Abosonsomfoɔ bisa Nyankopɔn ase kwa
1 # Hes 20.1 Na Israel mpanimfoɔ mu bi baa me nkyɛn bɛtenaa m’anim. 2Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 3#Hes 20.3 Onipa ba, mmarima yi de wɔn abosonhunu ahyɛ wɔn akomam, na wɔde wɔn amumuyɛ suntidua asisi wɔn anim. Memma wommisa me hɔ biribi mma wɔn? 4Enti kasa kyerɛ wɔn na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie a ɔde n’abosonhunu hyɛ n’akomam na ɔde n’amumuyɛ suntidua si n’ani soɔ, na ɔba odiyifoɔ nkyɛn no, me, AWURADE, mɛbua no ho bi, n’abosonhunu no dodoɔ so, 5na masɔ Israel fie no mu, wɔn akoma mu, sɛ wɔde wɔn abosonhunu no nyinaa ate wɔn ho afiri me ho no.
6 # Yes 31.6 Enti ka kyerɛ Israel fie sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Monsane na monnane mo ho mfiri mo abosonhunu no ho, na monnane mo ani mfiri mo akyiwadeɛ no nyinaa ho. 7Na obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie, anaa ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛyɛ Israel mu ɔhɔhoɔ no mu, na wawae afiri me ho, na ɔde n’abosonhunu hyɛ n’akoma mu, na ɔde n’amumuyɛ suntidua si n’ani soɔ, na ɔba odiyifoɔ nkyɛn bɛbisa no me hɔ adeɛ no, me AWURADE, me ara na mɛbua no. 8#Hes 5.15 Na mɛma m’ani asa onipa no, na mɛdwiri no ama no ayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne akasabebuo, na matwa no afiri me man mu, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.
9 # 1 Ah 22.20-23 Na sɛ odiyifoɔ no ma wɔdaadaa no na ɔka asɛm bi a, ɛnneɛ me, AWURADE, na madaadaa odiyifoɔ ko no, na mɛtene me nsa wɔ ne so asɛe no afiri me man Israel mu, 10na wɔasoa wɔn amumuyɛ no; sɛdeɛ ɔdebisani no amumuyɛ teɛ no, sɛ odiyifoɔ no amumuyɛ bɛyɛ ne no, 11#Hes 11.20 deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na Israel fie amfom kwan amfiri m’akyiri bio, na wɔamfa wɔn mmarato nyinaa angu wɔn ho fi bio, na wɔayɛ me ɔman, na me nso mayɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.
Ɔkwan titire a wɔfa soɔ ne ɔman no die
12Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 13#Hes 5.16 Onipa ba, sɛ asase bi yɛ me bɔne di afomfonsɛm bi, na metene me nsa wɔ so, na mebu ne paanoo dua mu, na mema ɛkɔm ba so, na metwa nnipa ne mmoa firi so, 14#Yer 15.1 na sɛ mmarima baasa yi, Noa, Daniel ne Hiob wɔ hɔ a, wɔn deɛ, wɔn tenenee ho na wɔbɛgye wɔn kra, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. 15#Hes 14.21 Sɛ mema mmoa bɔne kyini asase no so, na wɔdwerɛ ɛsofoɔ, na ɛdane afo a mmoa no nti obiara ntwam mfa so a, 16sɛ mmarima baasa yi wɔ so a, sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, ampa, mmabanin ne mmammaa mpo, wɔrennye wɔn; wɔn ara nko na wɔbɛgye wɔn, na asase no deɛ, ɛbɛdane afo. 17Anaasɛ mede nkrantɛ meba asase no so, na mese: Nkrantɛ, fa asase no so, na metwa nnipa ne mmoa firi so a, 18na mmarima baasa yi wɔ so a, sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, mmabanin ne mmammaa mpo, wɔrennye wɔn, na wɔn ara nko na wɔbɛgye wɔn. 19Anaasɛ mema owuyadeɛ ba asase no so, na mehwie m’abufuhyeɛ gu so, mogya mu, sɛ meretwa nnipa ne mmoa afiri so, 20na Noa, Daniel ne Hiob wɔ so a, sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, ampa, wɔrennye ɔbabanin ne ɔbabaa; na wɔn deɛ, wɔn tenenee so na wɔbɛgye wɔn kra.
21 # Lew 26.16-25; Yer 15.3 Na sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Na nkantom sɛ mɛma m’atemmudeɛ bɔne nnan, nkrantɛ ne ɛkɔm ne mmoa bɔne ne owuyadeɛ, aba Yerusalem so de atwa nnipa ne mmoa afiri so! 22Nanso, hwɛ, nnipa a wɔbɛfiri mu afire bɛka wɔn mu, mmammarima ne mmammaa, wɔde wɔn bɛfiri adi; hwɛ, wɔbɛfiri adi aba mo nkyɛn, na moahunu wɔn abrabɔ ne wɔn nneyɛɛ, na moakyekyere mo werɛ, bɔne a mede baa Yerusalem soɔ, adeɛ a mede baa soɔ no nyinaa ho. 23Na sɛ mohunu wɔn abrabɔ ne wɔn nneyɛɛ a, wɔbɛkyekyere mo werɛ, na moahunu sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔkwa na meyɛɛ adeɛ a meyɛɛ no wɔ wɔn mu no nyinaa, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.

Na Israel mpanimfoɔ mu bi baa me nkyɛn bɛtenaa m’anim. Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Onipa ba, mmarima yi de wɔn abosonhunu ahyɛ wɔn akomam, na wɔde wɔn amumuyɛ suntidua asisi wɔn anim. Memma wommisa me hɔ biribi mma wɔn? Enti kasa kyerɛ wɔn na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie a ɔde n’abosonhunu hyɛ n’akomam na ɔde n’amumuyɛ suntidua si n’ani soɔ, na ɔba odiyifoɔ nkyɛn no, me, AWURADE, mɛbua no ho bi, n’abosonhunu no dodoɔ so, na masɔ Israel fie no mu, wɔn akoma mu, sɛ wɔde wɔn abosonhunu no nyinaa ate wɔn ho afiri me ho no.
Enti ka kyerɛ Israel fie sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Monsane na monnane mo ho mfiri mo abosonhunu no ho, na monnane mo ani mfiri mo akyiwadeɛ no nyinaa ho. Na obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie, anaa ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛyɛ Israel mu ɔhɔhoɔ no mu, na wawae afiri me ho, na ɔde n’abosonhunu hyɛ n’akoma mu, na ɔde n’amumuyɛ suntidua si n’ani soɔ, na ɔba odiyifoɔ nkyɛn bɛbisa no me hɔ adeɛ no, me AWURADE, me ara na mɛbua no. Na mɛma m’ani asa onipa no, na mɛdwiri no ama no ayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne akasabebuo, na matwa no afiri me man mu, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.
Na sɛ odiyifoɔ no ma wɔdaadaa no na ɔka asɛm bi a, ɛnneɛ me, AWURADE, na madaadaa odiyifoɔ ko no, na mɛtene me nsa wɔ ne so asɛe no afiri me man Israel mu, na wɔasoa wɔn amumuyɛ no; sɛdeɛ ɔdebisani no amumuyɛ teɛ no, sɛ odiyifoɔ no amumuyɛ bɛyɛ ne no, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na Israel fie amfom kwan amfiri m’akyiri bio, na wɔamfa wɔn mmarato nyinaa angu wɔn ho fi bio, na wɔayɛ me ɔman, na me nso mayɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Onipa ba, sɛ asase bi yɛ me bɔne di afomfonsɛm bi, na metene me nsa wɔ so, na mebu ne paanoo dua mu, na mema ɛkɔm ba so, na metwa nnipa ne mmoa firi so, na sɛ mmarima baasa yi, Noa, Daniel ne Hiob wɔ hɔ a, wɔn deɛ, wɔn tenenee ho na wɔbɛgye wɔn kra, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. Sɛ mema mmoa bɔne kyini asase no so, na wɔdwerɛ ɛsofoɔ, na ɛdane afo a mmoa no nti obiara ntwam mfa so a, sɛ mmarima baasa yi wɔ so a, sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, ampa, mmabanin ne mmammaa mpo, wɔrennye wɔn; wɔn ara nko na wɔbɛgye wɔn, na asase no deɛ, ɛbɛdane afo. Anaasɛ mede nkrantɛ meba asase no so, na mese: Nkrantɛ, fa asase no so, na metwa nnipa ne mmoa firi so a, na mmarima baasa yi wɔ so a, sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, mmabanin ne mmammaa mpo, wɔrennye wɔn, na wɔn ara nko na wɔbɛgye wɔn. Anaasɛ mema owuyadeɛ ba asase no so, na mehwie m’abufuhyeɛ gu so, mogya mu, sɛ meretwa nnipa ne mmoa afiri so, na Noa, Daniel ne Hiob wɔ so a, sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, ampa, wɔrennye ɔbabanin ne ɔbabaa; na wɔn deɛ, wɔn tenenee so na wɔbɛgye wɔn kra.
Na sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Na nkantom sɛ mɛma m’atemmudeɛ bɔne nnan, nkrantɛ ne ɛkɔm ne mmoa bɔne ne owuyadeɛ, aba Yerusalem so de atwa nnipa ne mmoa afiri so! Nanso, hwɛ, nnipa a wɔbɛfiri mu afire bɛka wɔn mu, mmammarima ne mmammaa, wɔde wɔn bɛfiri adi; hwɛ, wɔbɛfiri adi aba mo nkyɛn, na moahunu wɔn abrabɔ ne wɔn nneyɛɛ, na moakyekyere mo werɛ, bɔne a mede baa Yerusalem soɔ, adeɛ a mede baa soɔ no nyinaa ho. Na sɛ mohunu wɔn abrabɔ ne wɔn nneyɛɛ a, wɔbɛkyekyere mo werɛ, na moahunu sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔkwa na meyɛɛ adeɛ a meyɛɛ no wɔ wɔn mu no nyinaa, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
